title: Monster_Girl_Mythology
description: Adds 20 unique girl-themed mobs! Get ready for new encounters and exciting battles in your world.
body:
[EN]
Bring a new touch of color to your Minecraft world with 'Monster Girl Mythology.'
Are you bored with the existing mobs? This mod adds 20 unique girl-themed monsters, bringing new threats and variety to your adventures.
Furthermore, discover the 'mysterious base' hidden somewhere in the Nether, where you can obtain unique items to enhance your exploration. Master the time-manipulating clock and specialized utility tools to gain an advantage in your survival journey!

[JP]
「Monster Girl Mythology」で、あなたのマインクラフトの世界に新たな彩りを
既存のモンスターに飽きていませんか？このMODは、20種類の個性豊かな女の子型モンスターを追加し、あなたの冒険に新たな脅威や多様性をもたらします。
さらに、ネザーのどこかに潜む「謎の拠点」と、そこで手に入るユニークなアイテムが、あなたの探索をより良いものにします。時間を操る時計や、特殊な状況で役立つ探索ツールを使いこなし、サバイバルを有利に進めよう！

![All mobs added by this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7460ff11d78811bf11f9f96edd97aa4e05d0ebf.png)

Features
20 Unique Mobs: Each mob features a distinct design and behavior. From mysterious creatures to dangerous foes, they will make your biomes feel more alive and challenging.

![enemy of the desert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9e1fb80ae79b564a8c669b3ad6c295f0d026b63.png)

Custom Items: Defeat these mobs to collect unique items. These drops are designed to assist your survival journey and add new tactical options to your combat.

Artistic Inspiration: The designs for these mobs were inspired by a rich variety of illustrations and games (e.g., from Pixiv), ensuring a unique aesthetic in Minecraft.

![Inside the Nether Castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d8881ace0cb62adf2d26af39d04eddcf6a04369.png)

Requirements
Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

GeckoLib (Essential for mob animations)

Important Notes
Redistribution: Redistribution of this mod is strictly prohibited.

Project Status: This is a finished "legacy" project created for practice. Please note that it will not receive further updates or content.

Original Article: For a deeper look into the design concepts and lore, you can check out the original article here (Note: The article is written in Japanese): https://note.com/futuden/n/n44aa2b068a5b
